content: Yuusufa ŋ kahan Potifaar
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yuusufa, wa Ismaayla-Ismaaylaaca ree na Yuusufa Misra, ɓa toon ɗe Potifaar ; a yi daga adgohee ƴaaɓa niiɗe kahan Firawnaana.
Nikiɗi huneen na Yuusufa te in nu a haɓɗeen ɗah, wa baah ; a nikka ŋ kahan kilifaanaŋ ɗe Potifaar.
Kilifaanaŋ ɗe hotta ne Nikiɗi huniɗ na Yuusufa te in nu a haɓiɗ ɗah, Nikiɗi baahiɗa.
Kilifaanaŋ ɗe baahohha ɗe, a degga ɗe ŋ serooce, Yuusufa adgohha kahan ce na raak-raakaŋ ɗe jen.
Wa Potifaar haɓiɗ ineem, Nikiɗi barke'iɗta kahan ce, in ca nikee nga na ca ŋ yohon caŋ ɗe jen, sagu Yuusufa.
Wa tahha po Potifaar faɗta in caŋ kahan ce jen ŋ yaah Yuusufa ; a taambkohisseeɗi ali in, nikɗi kañam kaŋ ɗe ɗah. Yuusufa na ɓiti Potifaar Yuusufa nikee moɗoh fiir.
Kaɗta po, ɓiti kilifaanaŋ ɗe hememmba ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne : « Haya fu faanuk na so ! »
Yuusufa sannga, a woosa ɗe ne : « Fu hot nga, kilifaaniŋ ngo oolkiɗ to po a haɓɗisɗi tus ŋ kahni, a faɗiɗ in ciŋ ɗe jen ŋ yaah ciŋ ngo.
A mi na ɗe hend ŋ kahni ; a sangiɗɗi so tus nikɗi fu ɗah, laam fu ɓitiice ; mbaa ŋ min na tumoh ini moɗaaɗiineem, ŋ tooñ Kooh ? »
A gennda gen ñaakiɗ Yuusufa na ineem, waaye tahɗi po a teyɗukka faanuk na ɗe.
Wa raakka mbeh, Yuusufa aassa ŋ kahna ne a panguk, raak surgaaca nikeeɗi ŋ ɗiska ;
ɓiti Potifaar ammba ɗe ŋ kulɓa, a woosa ɗe ne : « Haya ɓoo faanuk ! » Yuusufa nookukka, kulɓaaka tassa ŋ yaah caŋ ɗe ; Yuusufa saandohha ŋ hara.
Ɓitɓa inahha ne Yuusufa saandohiɗ te a faɗiɗ ɗe na kulɓaaka ŋ yaah caŋ ɗe,
a ɓeeɗukka surgaaca, a woosa ɓa ne : « Markaat ! Ɓoo komu kuɓu Heber ne a ɓasɗuk ɓoo ; a hayiɗ nga so ne a faanuk na so waaye ŋ leehukka ŋ ɗafka.
Wi ŋ leehuk, a saandohha, a faɗta kulɓaakiŋ ɗe ndii. »
A ɗaakka kulɓaakaŋ Yuusufa, a sekeeɗa hayiŋ ƴaar ce.
Wa ƴaar ce hay, a naandsukohha ɗe wa ɗaa, a woosa ɗe ne : « Ñaami Heberi fu ɓayiɗ ɓoo, a hayiɗ nga so ne a kelsukoh ho,
ŋ leehukka ŋ ɗafka, a saandohha, a faɗta kulɓaakiŋ ɗe ndii. »
Wa Potifaar kerah ina ɓitiice naandsuk ɗe ne weɗ Yuusufa haɓiɗ, a ayrukka.
A ambɗukka Yuusufa ne a taƴ ɗe ŋ kasoona ɓi kahan Firawnaana na ɗaakohse. Yuusufa nikka nga.
Yuusufa ŋ kasoona
Nikiɗi huneen na Yuusufa, a tummba po ƴaara adgohee kasoona baahohha ɗe.
Ƴaara faɗta ɓooɓa ambsee jen ŋ yaah Yuusufa, a adgohha pangkaŋ ɓa jen.
Ƴaara haɓɗisɗi ali in ŋ ina a nakee ɗe laam, a hoteen ne Nikiɗi huneen na Yuusufa te in nu a haɓiɗ ɗah, Nikiɗi baahiɗa.
